title: Isolated staging and controlled production promotion
goal: Separate staging and production infrastructure and allow production promotion only for an approved, fully verified release SHA

in: Separate Vercel and Supabase staging and production projects
Domain aliases, GitHub environments, scoped secrets, protected promotion, and deployment evidence

acceptance_criteria: demo.tourify.live resolves only to isolated staging and tourify.live/www resolve only to production
Staging and production databases, credentials, deployment IDs, and release SHA are demonstrably isolated
Production deployment cannot bypass required CI, E2E, security, or manual approval gates
Each deployment records its Git SHA, environment, migration evidence, deployment ID, and approver

evidence: Audit baseline: tourify.live and demo.tourify.live resolve to the same Vercel production deployment and project.
Audit baseline: GitHub environments have no scoped secrets or protection and main has no branch protection; Vercel deployed the live main SHA despite failing CI.

2026-09-22 read-only GET /api/health on demo.tourify.live and tourify.live: both returned 200 without x-tourify-release-sha and advertised the same Supabase connection origin in Content-Security-Policy. This does not prove separate staging deployment/database; no hosted mutation or credential access was attempted.

2026-09-22 local release/QA gate wave: 13 deployment/topology/evidence/workflow Node tests, 7 actor-provisioner tests, 7 mobile gate tests, launch fixture contract, public-surface check, focused ESLint, and workflow YAML parse passed. Hosted deployment, certification, and simulation were not run.

Public GET /api/health returned 200 on both; neither advertised release SHA, deployment ID, Supabase origin, or Stripe mode. Both CSPs allow auqddrodjezjlypkzfpi.supabase.co; CSP alone is not runtime DB-target proof. GitHub staging/production environments have 0 variables, 0 secrets, 0 protection rules; main branch protection returned 404. No deployment or database mutation occurred.

Focused local validation: 13/13 deployment/topology/evidence/workflow Node tests passed; npm run check:public-surface passed; npm run test:e2e:launch:contract passed. Full release verification and hosted staging run were not attempted.
